about.title: Meet Ghst
paragraphs: I'm Murilo Araujo, but everyone in the community knows me as Ghst. I wrote my first Lua scripts for FiveM roleplay servers in {startYear} and never looked back.

Building in-game interfaces led me to React and TypeScript; running servers pulled me into back end and infrastructure. These days I work across the whole stack: I design the system, build the UI, write the API and look after where it all runs.

Oh, and I have a law degree. I spent years with statutes and case law, but bugs, deploys and servers are where I feel at home. I swapped the law books for VS Code and never regretted it. Law didn't become my career, but it sharpened the way I see the world.

education.title: Bachelor of Laws
education.text: Trained in one field, at home in another.

journey.title: Leveling up, one stage at a time
journey.intro: From Lua scripts on a single roleplay server to leading tech for entire server groups. Here's how it went.

start.title: First spawn
start.text: It started with Lua scripts for roleplay servers and quickly turned into work: freelance gigs and consulting, shipping systems, interfaces and integrations that real players use in production.

growth.title: From NUIs to the web
growth.role: Front end, back end and infra
growth.text: Building in-game UIs pulled me into React and TypeScript. Next came Node.js and NestJS APIs, databases, Docker and deployments. FiveM turned out to be my way into full-stack development.

store.title: My own store
store.text: I built and run my own marketplace for FiveM scripts: catalog, automatic licensing, protected downloads, a customer dashboard and Discord integration. The whole product, from the first line of code to after-sales support.

leste.title: Technical leadership
leste.text: I led technology across the Fronteira Leste server group and was the sole developer behind Lado Leste: architecture, systems, interfaces and keeping the server running day to day.

wins.title: Current quest
wins.text: I work across every server in WinsVue's portfolio, one of the biggest companies in the FiveM scene: building systems, interfaces and integrations, and keeping the servers stable and growing.
